summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi COIN 2x Daily ETF (COIX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Coinbase Global, Inc. (TICKER: COIN), through derivatives such as swaps COIX was launched on Jun 26, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
